text:
Maya: Heads-up — large pilot asked for SAML SSO + event-level telemetry. That scope pushes the auth/telemetry work ~3w. We need to re-evaluate MVP: trim or shift to v1? Quick sync in 15?
Alex: If the pilot requires SAML we also need infra work (KMS/HSM, cert rotation) — adds work on infra/security side. Can we offer OIDC fallback to unblock the pilot faster?
Priya: UX note: enterprise IdP setup screens + cert upload flows are non-trivial; would add designer bandwidth. We could simplify by limiting initial setup to copy/paste metadata + test button.
Jordan: Suggestion: keep core product-mandatory pieces in MVP (email/invite auth, core routing) and treat SSO as "beta behind a flag" for the pilot only. Telemetry: send minimal auth + latency events in MVP; defer full event schema and analytics dashboard to v1.
Sam: Tech check — feature-flagged SSO still needs connector scaffolding and e2e. Rough dev estimate: 1.5w impl + 1w testing for OIDC; SAML is another ~1.5w.
Lila: From QA: if we limit MVP to OIDC we can keep the test matrix small. SAML will blow up permutations (cert types, redirects, signed assertions). Recommend deferring SAML to v1 unless pilot is non-negotiable.
Maya: OK — proposed cut list for MVP (draft):
  - Keep: email/password, invite flow, basic account recovery
  - Keep minimal telemetry: auth success/fail + request latency + error counts (no dashboards)
  - Defer to v1: SAML, analytics dashboards, policy management, advanced audit search
Is everyone comfortable with that tradeoff? This would let us target a smaller delay (~2w) instead of 3+.
Alex: +1. Also recommend we add a compatibility note in the pilot contract: full SAML support targeted for v1.
Priya: :thumbsup: I can produce a condensed SSO setup UX that fits the MVP constraint (tomorrow).
Jordan: Action items: Maya updates cut list + milestone; Alex & Sam provide final dev/infra estimates by EOD; Priya drops mock by EOD tomorrow; Lila drafts minimal SSO test plan.
Sam: Also, dev note — we'll need a feature flag gating and a small telemetry sampling config so pilot telemetry doesn't spike costs. I can add a small config endpoint.
Lila: QA will need a short regression checklist for core auth flows and a smoke test for telemetry ingestion. I'll post a template in #qa-scripts.
Maya: Thanks. If we all agree, new milestone = shift by 2 weeks (target date 2092612345). I'll send an updated milestone plan and rollout notes after EOD.
Alex: Fine with 2w shift. We should also call out rollback plan in case pilot needs SAML earlier.
Jordan: Noted. We'll keep an emergency path: short-lived SAML proxy we can enable for the pilot if absolutely required, but that is last resort.
Maya: Cool — meeting cancelled for now. We'll reconvene after the estimate updates. Thanks everyone.
